user_input: Write a 3 paragraph short story about a woman named Katie who ties up her Cousin Billy and forces him to dress as a girl
model_output:
Katie had always been fascinated by her cousin Billy, who was a few years older than her. She had always admired his strong, muscular build and his rugged, handsome features. One day, she decided that she wanted to spend some quality time with him, and she came up with a strange plan.

Katie convinced Billy to come over to her house, under the pretext of wanting to play a game of dress-up. When he arrived, she quickly tied him up with some ropes she had hidden in her room, and forced him to put on a frilly dress and a pair of high heels. Billy was shocked and outraged, but Katie was insistent, and he soon found himself struggling against the ropes, trying to free himself.

Katie enjoyed Billy's discomfort and struggles, and she continued to torment him, forcing him to wear more and more feminine clothes and makeup. She even made him pose for pictures, and she posted them on social media, causing a stir among her friends and family. Billy was humiliated and embarrassed, but he knew that he had to somehow escape from Katie's clutches.

Finally, after hours of torture, Billy managed to break free from the ropes, and he ran out of the house, vowing never to speak to Katie again. He was bruised and battered, but he was determined to put the experience behind him, and to move on with his life.
